notes.title: [INTERNAL ANNOUNCEMENT | CCC-PR-DL002 | LAUNCH OF NIGHTHOLD: NUMBER 1 PAGE]
notes.content:
[h3]THE FIRST CHAPTER OF YOUR ADVENTURE - OFFICIALLY OPEN.[/h3]
Trainee, we’re pleased to inform you that the official page for Nighthold: Number 1 is now live - a free, introductory version of the Nighthold project.
You are invited to participate in reconstructing the chain of events that nearly wiped out our (and your) expedition.

[previewyoutube=gNAjI9Q179E;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]🔍 MISSION BACKGROUND:[/h3]
The captain (officially designated as Number 1) also survived the crash and performed an emergency landing on the planet’s surface.
 The landing was… less than ideal.
As a result, the captain has lost all memories - including critical information about what really happened aboard the ship.
 Cosmos Colonization Corp™ strongly recommends retrieving this data.

[h3]🧭 YOUR OBJECTIVES:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Explore a mysterious, dangerous, and decidedly unfriendly planet.
[*] Recover information from black boxes and (if you're lucky) from coherent local survivors.
[*] Defend yourself from the Rot, avoid radiation, and, of course, tend to basic survival needs. (Even with a concussion, you’re still expected to eat.)
[/list]
[h3]📌 ADD NIGHTHOLD: NUMBER 1 TO YOUR WISHLIST[/h3]
Be among the first to experience what it's like to be a captain when everything goes wrong.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3823970/Nighthold_Number_1/?beta=1

Survive. Or at least remember to leave feedback.
 Sincerely,
 Department of Initial Losses and Forward Projections
 Cosmos Colonization Corp™

notes.title: [INTERNAL MEMORANDUM | CCC-PR-DL001 | NEW PERSONNEL ORIENTATION BRIEFING]
notes.content:
[p][b]WELCOME, RECRUIT!
[/b]Congratulations on your first day of service at [i]Cosmos Colonization Corp™[/i] — the leading galactic authority in planetary settlement, exploitation, and (when necessary) radical reconfiguration of alien worlds.
You've made the best choice of your short — and possibly heroic — life.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]🛠 CORPORATE PROPERTY[/b][/h3][p]Please remember: everything you touch is the property of [i]Cosmos Colonization Corp™[/i].
Your suit, your boots, your spoon, your thoughts — all officially logged corporate inventory.
Any damage, wear, or… bloodstained evidence of incidents will be deducted from your paycheck.
Or your family’s, should you fail to make it to the next payroll cycle.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]
[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdOlngB4RxMUsgq5Sa0f38-PrwDowo08nCeh3xx8D0gsbIbiFNvaI4p5wKVgR_oaXbecFNFHvu_Z3n5isbmLe3Fq_tqd_MQ_bU_GgrsYaE2n4t2FUhCg2LgTHQIKQJKRPiC0yBlKg?key=JEyX8rB8p4sF6cCreXkpsw"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]📕 EMERGENCY PROTOCOL IN CASE OF SHIP FAILURE[/b][/h3][p][b]1. Evacuate the ship.
[/b]Do not panic. [i]Cosmos Colonization Corp™[/i] will take care of you.
Proceed to the nearest escape pod and hold on tight.
Your chances of survival are roughly those of a slice of bread in a toaster — but at least it makes for a beautiful fireball.[/p][p][b]2. Follow assigned objectives.
[/b]Your hip-mounted personal computer — the [i]CosmoPad™[/i] — knows exactly what to do and will generate an optimized action plan to help you survive and/or collect valuable scientific data.
Sometimes — both.[/p][p][b]3. Document everything.
[/b]Knowledge is power. Especially when [i]you[/i] are the data source.
Bitten by an alien lifeform? Log your symptoms. Dying of radiation? Describe the sensations.
Your suffering is not in vain — it serves science. And may even benefit future, luckier employees.[/p][p][b]4. Trust only CCC™.
[/b]Local natives, wild lifeforms, other survivors — all are potential threats.
Only the corporation sincerely cares about you.
(This statement is contractually binding and may be used in promotional material.)[/p][p][b]5. Drink water. Eat food. Sleep occasionally.
[/b]Your body is a corporate asset.
We’ve invested heavily in you — fuel, cryochamber time, paperwork.
Please don’t disappoint our investment.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]🔜 IN THE NEXT ORIENTATION BRIEFING:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]How to build a shelter that might survive the night. [/p][/*][*][p]Why you shouldn’t bring alien artifacts into residential zones. [/p][/*][*][p]And most importantly — how to identify if your neighbor is infected without hurting their feelings. [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]If you — or your friends — have not yet signed a contract with [i]Cosmos Colonization Corp™[/i], don’t miss your chance!
Add [b]Nighthold[/b] to your wishlist here:
